title: Otter holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 40 Q64 55 58 68' stroke='#ffd76a' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='26' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='21' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ff9db0'/>
  <path d='M62 42 l-3 4 h6 z' fill='#e04060'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='76' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#8a5a3c'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='82' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#d9a86a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='52' r='17' fill='#9c6a44'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='5' fill='#9c6a44'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='40' r='5' fill='#9c6a44'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#c98f63'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#c98f63'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='60' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#e8c39a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='50' r='3' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='50' r='3' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='49' r='1' fill='#fff2c0'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='49' r='1' fill='#fff2c0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='57' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#4a2a3a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M45 59.5 Q42 63 39 61' stroke='#6a4030' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M45 59.5 Q48 63 51 61' stroke='#6a4030' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M34 57 l-8 -2' stroke='#c98f63' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M34 60 l-8 1' stroke='#c98f63' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M56 57 l8 -2' stroke='#c98f63' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M56 60 l8 1' stroke='#c98f63' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- arm holding string -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='70' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#9c6a44' transform='rotate(-25 60 70)'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='78' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#9c6a44' transform='rotate(20 28 78)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='93' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#7a4a30'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='93' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#7a4a30'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#7a4a30' transform='rotate(-20 24 88)'/>
</svg>
